notify.bot.expired: The code has expired. Make a new one to link.
notify.bot.linked: The Zalo Bot is linked. Digests and alerts arrive in the chat with the Bot.
notify.bot.failed.linked: Your Zalo Bot is already linked.
notify.bot.failed.tooMany: You made 5 codes within an hour. Try again later.
notify.bot.failed.notAllowed: You cannot make a link code. Ask the owner to link the Zalo Bot for you.

notify.mute.noRules: Your role receives no kind of message yet.
